reference: A: My name is Lily. I volunteer at the community library on Saturdays. I go there at nine o'clock in the morning. I help put books on the shelves. I work with two other volunteers. We are a team. We start at nine and finish at twelve. We take a short break at ten thirty. We drink tea and talk. B: My friend Tom volunteers on Sundays. He works from ten to two. He reads to children.
